create_RolloutStorage: create a RolloutStorage instance to store rollout data for RL training with observations, actions, and rewards buffers
insert_rollout_data: insert observations, actions, rewards, and value predictions into the RolloutStorage buffer at the current step
compute_returns_GAE: compute discounted returns using Generalized Advantage Estimation or simple Monte Carlo returns in RolloutStorage
generate_recurrent_mini_batches: generate shuffled mini-batch tensors from RolloutStorage buffers for recurrent policy network training updates
review_RolloutStorage_after_update: review the RolloutStorage after_update method that resets step indices and copies the last step to index zero
